Energy

Summary of who wasted the most energy and who cost the enemy the most energy.
Calculated by adding up Losses (and Stalemates, Defends, Escapes, Interrupts) and Defends, the multiplying the number by 25.
E_Wasted means the member spent X energy on attacks that failed.
E_Stolen means X energy was wasted by the enemy on attacking the member unsuccessfully.
You might want to take a closer look at members with high E_Wasted values and remind them to pick fights they can win!

1 These numbers will be 0 if you are using an API key WITHOUT faction access.

Here is a summary of the provided combat data:

Overall Faction Performance

The faction shows mixed performance in this war. A significant proportion of members (25 out of 28, or 89.3%) engaged in war hits, indicating good participation. However, the prevalence of wasted energy (E_Wasted) across multiple members suggests inefficiencies in attacking strategies. There's a notable range in Net_Score, with some members contributing positively while others negatively impacted the overall score. The activity levels also vary greatly, with some members being highly active and others barely participating.

Areas for Improvement

  1. Energy Efficiency: Reduce E_Wasted by improving target selection and attack timing.
  2. Coordination: Enhance coordination to increase assists, particularly among members with lower war hits.
  3. Resource Utilization: Optimize the use of boosters, cans, and refills to maximize impact during war time.

Individual Highlights: Positive

  • Benedicc: Stands out with 153 War_Hits and a high Net_Score of 507.36, indicating effective attacking and good target selection.
  • Merle-DicksIn: High War_Hits (114) and assists (5), contributing significantly to the faction's offensive efforts, with a high Net_Score of 446.64.
  • Supreme_: High War_Hits (88) and a high assist count of 21 suggesting this player is an effective team player.
  • cutt: High Non_War_Hits (97) and a Net_Score of 231.39.
  • RipleyWolf: Shows good activity (12.742 hours) and a positive Net_Score (340.63), contributing well to the faction. Also has high amount of Assists (9).

Individual Highlights: Negative

  • Mystic_Music: High hospital visits (51) and a significantly negative Net_Score (-257.23), indicating difficulties in combat and potential resource mismanagement.
  • -Asphodel: High hospital visits (58) and a negative Net_Score (-130.96), suggesting this player might need guidance on attack strategies or target selection.
  • SomeBOT: High hospital visits (35) and a negative Net_Score of -205.94.

Additional Observations

  • Harleequiin: Has a high number of hospital visits (21) and a negative Net_Score (-103.55), coupled with a high E_Wasted (175). This player may need guidance on attack strategies and target selection.
  • Blazinowl, 25mg-brenadryl, idrawfurrys, Soultea: High hospital visits and negative Net_Score - these players may need guidance on attack strategies and target selection.
  • There is a wide range of level differences among members, but performance does not directly correlate with level. Lower-level players can still contribute effectively with the right strategies and support.
